params.prompt: A full-page website design, desktop 1440 wide, for a welding shop's contact page: a light-grey panel held inside a welded steel frame, the weld beads visible at the corners, brushed steel around it, the attached chrome emblem mounted above the panel. On the panel: heading "Tell me about the job", one short line, four form fields (Name, Phone, What do you need built or fixed?, Where is it?), a teal-blue button "Send the request", and three ways in: "Text 425-283-6496", "Call", "Instagram". Masculine, industrial, crisp, legible, no rust, no wood, no pastels.
